title: Libtt: A Compiler and Runtime for Tenstorrent Processors
abstract: arXiv:2611.34273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Libtt brings the PyTorch and JAX ecosystem to Tenstorrent hardware. It implements PJRT, the interface through which XLA-based frameworks drive Google's TPUs, so JAX runs on it directly, PyTorch runs through TorchTPU, and software written for TPUs carries over with no changes except replacing custom kernels. Built on Tenstorrent's open-source compiler and runtime, libtt ships the entire stack, from the compiler to the multi-chip runtime, as a single shared library. It contains extensive fixes to the upstream Tenstorrent software to make existing PyTorch and JAX code work out of the box, and extensive new compiler optimizations to make it fast. It passes most of the JAX and TorchTPU test suites and runs SGLang, TorchTitan, and Miles, covering serving, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.

translated_title: Libtt：面向 Tenstorrent 处理器的编译器与运行时
translated_abstract: Libtt 将 PyTorch 和 JAX 生态系统引入 Tenstorrent 硬件。它实现了 PJRT——XLA 框架驱动谷歌 TPU 所使用的接口——因此 JAX 可以直接在其上运行，PyTorch 通过 TorchTPU 运行，为 TPU 编写的软件只需替换自定义内核即可无缝迁移。Libtt 基于 Tenstorrent 的开源编译器和运行时构建，将从编译器到多芯片运行时的整个技术栈打包为单个共享库发布。它对上游 Tenstorrent 软件进行了大量修复，使现有的 PyTorch 和 JAX 代码能够开箱即用，并加入了大量新的编译器优化以提升运行速度。它通过了大部分 JAX 和 TorchTPU 测试套件，并能运行 SGLang、TorchTitan 和 Miles，覆盖推理服务、微调和强化学习等应用场景。
tldr: Libtt 通过实现 PJRT 接口将 PyTorch 和 JAX 生态系统完整移植到 Tenstorrent 硬件，以单个共享库提供从编译器到多芯片运行时的全栈方案，并借助大量修复和编译器优化使现有面向 TPU 的代码开箱即用且高效运行。
en_tdlr: Libtt brings the PyTorch and JAX ecosystem to Tenstorrent hardware by implementing the PJRT interface and shipping the entire compiler-to-multi-chip-runtime stack as a single shared library, with extensive fixes and new compiler optimizations enabling existing TPU-targeted code to run out of the box and fast.
